name: voice-typer-desktop
description: Tauri desktop shell for Voice Typer
//engines_note: Node 24 is the CURRENT TARGET. Do NOT downgrade to Node 20 (deprecated on GitHub Actions 2025-09-19). If a newer LTS is available, bump this comment AND the engines.node AND .nvmrc AND all .github/workflows/*.yml files together. Node 20 deprecation also causes [DEP0040] punycode DeprecationWarning noise in CI logs.
//overrides_note: Force-upgrades for transitive deps pulled by the remaining vite/tailwind/vitest/shadcn tooling chain. As of 2026-08-04, `npm audit` reports 0 vulnerabilities after overrides. Electron-only overrides (@electron/asar, @electron/get, undici, @xmldom/xmldom, js-yaml) were removed with the Electron shell.
author: Abdallah IsDev
//overrides_annotations: JSON has no comments, so each override's rationale lives in a sibling `//overrides_<pkg>` key (npm ignores keys starting with `//`). See //overrides_note for the chain-level rationale.
//overrides_@hono/node-server: force-upgrade to ^2.0.11 — patches the path-traversal advisory in the static-file handler.
//overrides_brace-expansion: force-upgrade to ^5.0.9 — replaces the deprecated brace-expansion@1 (glob@7) engine with the maintained 5.x line.
//overrides_ip-address: force-upgrade to ^10.3.1 — resolves the IPv6-parsing ReDoS advisory in ip-address@9 (npm-audit finding).
//overrides_fast-uri: force-upgrade to ^3.1.6 — resolves the ReDoS advisory in fast-uri@2, ajv-compiler chain (npm-audit finding).
//overrides_hono: force-upgrade to ^4.12.34 — keeps hono on a patched 4.x aligned with the @hono/node-server override.
//overrides_postcss: force-upgrade to ^8.5.23 — resolves the postcss@8 parser advisories pulled by vite/tailwind build tooling (npm-audit finding).
//overrides_nanoid: force-upgrade to ^3.3.18 — postcss pulls nanoid ^3.3.16 which resolves to 3.3.17, vulnerable to GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 (custom generators loop indefinitely when size is zero).
//overrides_browserslist: force-upgrade to ^4.28.9 - resolves the GHSA-73wf normalizeStats crash/prototype-write advisory in browserslist<=4.28.6 pulled by vitest 5 istanbul babel chain (dev-only).
//overrides_qs: force-upgrade to ^6.16.0 - resolves the GHSA-4mjr/x5fp qs DoS advisories in qs<6.16.0 pulled by the shadcn CLI express chain (dev-only).
//overrides_postcss-selector-parser: force-upgrade to ^7.1.6 - resolves the GHSA-w9m9 AST-recursion DoS advisory in postcss-selector-parser<7.1.3 (dev-only).
